propertySets.name: Pset_DiscreteAccessoryTypeInsulator
propertySets.definition: Properties of an insulator. The property set can be used by the predefined type INSULATOR of IfcDiscreteAccessory.

properties.name: RatedCurrent
properties.definition: The current that a device is designed to handle.

properties.name: RatedVoltage
properties.definition: The range of allowed voltage that a device is certified to handle. The upper bound of this value is the maximum.

properties.name: InsulationVoltage
properties.definition:
The insulation voltage.

The max voltage for normal insulation operation.

properties.name: BreakdownVoltageTolerance
properties.definition: Nominal value of the spark gap breakdown voltage tolerance.

properties.name: OperationalTemperatureRange
properties.definition: The temperature range in which the device operates normally.

properties.name: CreepageDistance
properties.definition: Shortest distance or the sum of the shortest distances along the surface on an insulator between two conductive parts which normally have the operating voltage between them. (IEV ref 471-01-04)

properties.name: InstallationMethod
properties.definition: Method of installation of cable/conductor. Installation methods are typically defined by reference in standards such as IEC 60364-5-52, table 52A-1 or BS7671 Appendix 4 Table 4A1 etc. Selection of the value to be used should be determined from such a standard according to local usage.

properties.name: LightningPeakVoltage
properties.definition: The peak lightning voltage that the insulator could withstand.

properties.name: RMSWithstandVoltage
properties.definition: Rms value of sinusoidal power frequency voltage that the insulation of the given equipment can withstand during tests made under specified conditions and for a specified duration. (IEV ref 614-03-22）

properties.name: Voltage
properties.definition: The actual voltage and operable range.

propertySets.name: Pset_SectionInsulator
propertySets.definition: Properties applicable to the insulator type of discrete accessory, indicated that the insulator is a section insulator used in the overhead contact line system.

properties.name: NumberOfWires
properties.definition: The number of wires used in the element.

properties.name: IsArcSuppressing
properties.definition: Indicates whether the element has the ability to suppress an arc.

properties.name: TensileStrength
properties.definition: Indicates the ability to withstand breakage apart under applied force.

propertySets.name: Pset_SectioningDevice
propertySets.definition: Properties of sectioning device used in railway. The property set can be used by the predefined type INSULATOR of IfcDiscreteAccessory.
